events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th today! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo anthem that just screams 'LG'?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (UK single) anniversary
events.blurb: Forty-one years ago today, John Lennon's iconic single "Imagine" was released in the UK, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' hit the UK charts. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the first iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or the Bond song that always gets you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, a visionary artist and peace activist.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary English comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your all-time favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every side of the Fab Four. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like "Norwegian Wood", was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound and songwriting. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, a musical legend whose influence continues to resonate globally.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, a voice for peace, love, and imagination, whose legacy lives on through his timeless music.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, a true pioneer of music and style.

angles.name: David Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and boundless creativity of David Bowie. Which era of Bowie defines him for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we pay tribute to the legendary Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of some of rock's most iconic riffs. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin guitar moment?
